title: Insurers' Denial of Care Puts Patients at Risk
discussion_signal: The discussion frames prior authorization and coverage denials as a conversion of clinical recommendations into delay, appeals, financial exposure, and trust loss. It makes the household and professional experience of denial visible while also showing the advocacy and accountability claims attached to it.
linked_research_question: How do insurance denials convert medical need into delay, debt, appeal work, and changing trust in care institutions?
limits: The post is advocacy and does not estimate denial prevalence
Individual stories in the discussion are not representative
Policy claims about liability are not legal findings
